benchmark_metric_provenance.routing_intent_oos_ambiguity_slots: Independent expected labels; numerators/denominators. Callback unit tests are not model-quality evidence.
benchmark_metric_provenance.semantic_contract_post_execution: Independent executable case oracles required; missing oracle reports NOT_MEASURED
benchmark_metric_provenance.latency: perf_counter callback interval including sampler overhead
benchmark_metric_provenance.TTFT: Actual first generated token timestamps in real_runtime_validation.json; smoke observations only
benchmark_metric_provenance.token_count: Actual generated token IDs from runtime only
benchmark_metric_provenance.tokens_per_second: Runtime token count divided by actual runtime inference duration
benchmark_metric_provenance.peak_memory: Sampled process RSS/PSS at 5 ms where supported; not isolated model memory or guaranteed instantaneous peak
benchmark_metric_provenance.model_size: Filesystem stat of actual asset, never descriptor estimate
benchmark_metric_provenance.real_model_quality: NOT_EVALUATED; training/inference smoke is not quality evidence

hardware_measurements.snapshot_provenance: Instantaneous report-generation Python process; not model memory, peak memory or test-process memory
hardware_measurements.runtime_observations: real_runtime_validation.json (load RSS delta, load latency, three actual inference samples; not peak or distribution claims)

known_limitations: General language quality is unevaluated; declared full-match grammars remain the default controller.
Frozen G6/G7 timing thresholds are preserved; initial full-suite failures and successful isolated rechecks are both retained in test artifacts.
First-party in-process tools are trusted. Restricted workers need Linux bubblewrap or Windows WSL Ubuntu; probes are not a comprehensive sandbox audit.
Registry lifecycle assumes a single host writer; use explicit database paths for durability.
Dependencies support exact versions; semver ranges are unsupported.
RSS load deltas and sampled process peaks do not guarantee OOM prevention or isolate model allocations.
Native inference timeout is cooperative between tokens.
Supervised trainer supports Llama-family down_proj LoRA only; its one-example smoke establishes execution, not learning quality.
Replay admission and evaluator callbacks require a trusted host and independent gold datasets. Replay storage is in-memory.
Host scheduling invokes active-adapter regression evaluation; scalar telemetry does not approve deployment.
Adapters target a host-defined model ID; hosts must use immutable model identities when replacing base assets.
Pattern redaction is not universal PII detection; raw query/slots and arbitrary exception strings are excluded from persisted experiences.
HTTP connectors require configured allowed endpoints; no production travel/weather provider is configured.
External-source provenance is required for schemas.external_sources; other env inputs remain trusted host inputs.
No Android or multi-model controller performance/quality claims are made.
test_result_aggregation: Latest result per test across the initial full suite, final 97-test platform rerun and isolated G6/G7 rerun; not a single all-green full-suite invocation.
